context: Project review for the Orchard mobile app. Team: Dan (project lead), Tessa (design), Marco (backend). The plan says launch on 6 March with five features. The vendor shortlist for the payment service is Alder Pay and Birch Pay.

lines.text: Thanks both. We need three decisions today, scope, payment vendor and date.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I have been through the design backlog and it is too much for one release.
Understood. Tessa, give me your view on the cuts.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I am cutting the scope to two features, the order flow and the profile page, so we can ship on time.
That is a big cut. I will take it to the sponsors.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: For payments we will go with Birch Pay, since it has the longer warranty and the cheaper fee.
Fine, I will note Birch Pay as the choice.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: The launch moves to the twentieth of March because the store review takes two weeks.
Then the plan changes from the sixth to the twentieth.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I will send the new design files by Friday.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: I will not take on the analytics work, that stays out of this release.
Analytics goes to the next release then.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: The team agreed that we only test on phones from the last three years.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: My cat knocked a plant onto my keyboard this morning.
That sounds like a long morning.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Same, I had three coffees already.
